methodology.repeats: 3 deterministic, 1 large-cardinality boundary, 1 per seeded randomized fixture; sequential one-shot CUDA jobs. No tuned clocks, OS cache reset or matched optimized candidate.
methodology.hostPreprocessing: Standalone qualified packer includes incremental NEW reconstruction. Fixture/pending-update derivation occurs before measurement. runtimePreparationMs measures execute entry through artifact read/parse/pack/workspace write to runner entry.
methodology.nativeWall: supervisedNativeWallMs is WSL/setsid/native one-shot spawn-to-close, including initialization and teardown; runnerWallMs additionally includes fresh launch qualification.
methodology.kernel: Existing native CUDA event interval surrounds host launch submission, not isolated GPU active duration. Actual GPU active times are separately measured in Nsight traces.
methodology.endToEnd: HTTP workflow preparation/upload/admission through accepted result retrieval/validation; excludes independent oracle and standalone packing measurements.
methodology.oracle: Independent set oracle on bounded fixtures; analytic zero/coincident/hub/chain formulas for larger cases. CPU is validation only, never a production fallback.
methodology.peakDeviceMemory: null unless a reliable profiler allocation trace is available separately; global nvidia-smi usage is not attributed peak memory.
